newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND STICK WITH WINNING COMBINATION.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND STICK WITH WINNING COMBINATION.

text.p: England will field an unchanged team for the third successive Five Nations game when they face France at Twickenham on March 1.
Coach Jack Rowell has resisted the temptation to tinker with the unbeaten side who have already registered record wins over both Scotland and Ireland, scoring 10 tries in the process.

It means that Jeremy Guscott and Austin Healey must be content with places on the replacements' bench despite their impressive late contributions to the 46-6 thrashing of Ireland at Lansdowne Road last weekend.

Team: 15-Tim Stimpson; 14-Jon Sleightholme, 13-Will Carling, 12-Phil de Glanville (captain), 11-Tony Underwood, 10-Paul Grayson, 9-Andy Gomarsall; 8-Tim Rodber, 7-Richard Hill, 6-Lawrence Dallaglio, 5-Simon Shaw, 4-Martin Johnson, 3-Jason Leonard, 2-Mark Regan, 1-Graham Rowntree.
Replacements: Jeremy Guscott, Mike Catt, Austin Healey, Darren Garforth, Phil Greening, Ben Clarke.
